ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Differences in geology and climate make soils in different regions more or less capable of sustained agriculture. In particular, the abundant rainfall and high weathering rates on the gentle slopes of many tropical landscapes mean that after enough time, rainfall seeping into the ground leaches out almost all of the nutrients from both the soil and the weathered rocks beneath the soil. Once this happens, the lush vegetation essentially feeds on itself, retaining and recycling nutrients inherited from rocks weathered long ago. As most of the nutrients in these areas reside not in the soil but in the plants themselves, once the native vegetation disappears, so does the productive capacity of the soil. Often too few nutrients remain to support either crops or livestock within decades of deforestation. Nutrient-poor tropical soils illustrate the general rule that life depends on recycling past life.

questions.passage: Differences in geology and climate make soils in different regions more or less ①<u>capable</u> of sustained agriculture. In particular, the abundant rainfall and high weathering rates on the gentle slopes of many tropical landscapes mean that after enough time, rainfall ②<u>seeped</u> into the ground leaches out almost all of the nutrients from both the soil and the weathered rocks beneath the soil. Once this happens, the lush vegetation essentially feeds on itself, ③<u>retaining</u> and recycling nutrients ④<u>inherited</u> from rocks weathered long ago. As most of the nutrients in these areas reside not in the soil but in the plants themselves, once the native vegetation disappears, so does the productive capacity of the soil. Often too few nutrients remain to support either crops or livestock within decades of deforestation. Nutrient-poor tropical soils illustrate the general rule that life depends on recycling past life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② seeped → seeping: 'rainfall seeping into the ground'에서 현재분사 seeping이 rainfall을 수식하는 분사구문이므로 seeped(과거분사)는 부적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① capable: 'more or less capable of sustained agriculture'에서 형용사로 적절
❌ ② seeped → seeping: 'rainfall seeped into the ground leaches out'에서 rainfall이 현재 스며드는 중임을 나타내는 현재분사 seeping이 필요. seeped(과거분사)는 수동/완료를 나타내어 의미상 부적절 ←정답
✅ ③ retaining: 'feeds on itself, retaining and recycling nutrients'에서 분사구문의 현재분사로 적절
✅ ④ inherited: 'nutrients inherited from rocks'에서 과거분사로 nutrients를 수식하여 적절
det.tip: rainfall seeping into the ground — 현재분사 seeping은 rainfall이 '스며드는 중'임을 나타내는 분사구문이다. seeped(과거분사)는 수동/완료 의미여서 이 문맥에 맞지 않는다.

questions.passage: Differences in geology and climate ①<u>make</u> soils in different regions more or less capable of sustained agriculture. As most of the nutrients in these areas reside not in the soil but in the plants themselves, once the native vegetation disappears, so ④<u>is</u> the productive capacity of the soil. Often too few nutrients remain to support either crops or livestock within decades of deforestation. Nutrient-poor tropical soils illustrate the general rule that life depends on recycling past life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ is → does: 'so does the productive capacity'에서 앞 동사 disappears를 대신하는 대동사 does가 필요. is는 대동사로 부적절
det.analysis:
✅ ① make: 'Differences make soils'에서 복수 주어에 맞는 동사 원형으로 적절
✅ ② mean: 'the abundant rainfall and high weathering rates mean that'에서 복수 주어에 맞는 동사 원형으로 적절
✅ ③ feeds: 'the lush vegetation feeds on itself'에서 단수 주어 vegetation에 맞는 3인칭 단수 동사로 적절
❌ ④ is → does: 'once the native vegetation disappears, so is the productive capacity of the soil'에서 앞 동사 disappears를 받는 대동사 does가 필요. is는 be동사로 disappears를 대신할 수 없음 ←정답
det.tip: so does S = S도 역시 그렇다. 앞 문장의 일반동사(disappears)를 대신하려면 대동사 does가 필요하다. is는 be동사를 대신하는 경우에만 사용한다.

questions.passage: Differences in geology and climate make soils in different regions more or ①<u>fewer</u> capable of sustained agriculture. In particular, the abundant rainfall and high weathering rates on the gentle slopes of many tropical landscapes mean that after enough time, rainfall seeping into the ground leaches out ②<u>almost</u> all of the nutrients from both the soil and the weathered rocks beneath the soil. Once this happens, the lush vegetation ③<u>essentially</u> feeds on itself, retaining and recycling nutrients inherited from rocks weathered long ago. As most of the nutrients in these areas reside not in the soil but in the plants ④<u>themselves</u>, once the native vegetation disappears, so does the productive capacity of the soil. Often too few nutrients remain to support either crops or livestock within decades of deforestation. Nutrient-poor tropical soils illustrate the general rule that life depends on recycling past life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① fewer → less: 'more or less capable'에서 정도를 나타내는 부사 less가 필요. fewer는 수량(가산명사)에 쓰이며 형용사 capable을 수식할 수 없음
det.analysis:
❌ ① fewer → less: 'more or fewer capable'에서 형용사 capable을 수식하는 부사가 필요. less(정도가 덜한)가 올바르며, fewer(수가 더 적은)는 가산명사 앞에서만 사용 ←정답
✅ ② almost: 'leaches out almost all of the nutrients'에서 부사로 all을 수식하여 적절
✅ ③ essentially: 'essentially feeds on itself'에서 부사로 동사 feeds를 수식하여 적절
✅ ④ themselves: 'in the plants themselves'에서 재귀대명사/강조용법으로 the plants를 강조하여 적절
det.tip: less vs fewer: less는 불가산명사 또는 부사(정도)로, fewer는 가산명사의 수에 사용한다. capable(형용사)을 수식하므로 부사 less가 맞다.

questions.passage: Differences in geology and climate make soils in different regions more or less capable of sustained agriculture. In particular, the abundant rainfall and high weathering rates on the gentle slopes of many tropical landscapes mean that after ①<u>enough</u> time, rainfall seeping into the ground leaches out almost all of the nutrients from ②<u>both</u> the soil and the weathered rocks beneath the soil. Once this happens, the lush vegetation essentially feeds on itself, retaining and recycling nutrients inherited from rocks weathered long ago. As most of the nutrients in these areas reside ③<u>not in the soil and in the plants themselves</u>, once the native vegetation disappears, so does the productive capacity of the soil. Often too few nutrients remain to support ④<u>either</u> crops or livestock within decades of deforestation. Nutrient-poor tropical soils illustrate the general rule that life depends on recycling past life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ and → but: 'not in the soil but in the plants themselves'에서 not A but B(A가 아니라 B) 구문이므로 and가 아닌 but이 필요
det.analysis:
✅ ① enough: 'after enough time'에서 형용사로 time을 수식하여 적절
✅ ② both: 'from both the soil and the weathered rocks'에서 both A and B 구문으로 적절
❌ ③ and → but: 'reside not in the soil and in the plants themselves'에서 not A but B(A가 아니라 B) 상관접속사 구문이므로 but이 필요. not A and B는 비문 ←정답
✅ ④ either: 'support either crops or livestock'에서 either A or B 구문으로 적절
det.tip: not A but B = A가 아니라 B. 이 구문에서 and를 쓰면 의미가 완전히 달라진다. 영양분은 토양에가 아니라 식물 자체에 존재한다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② absorbs(흡수하다) → leaches(용탈하다): 빗물이 영양분을 '용탈한다(leaches out)'는 원문인데 absorbs(흡수하다)는 정반대
det.analysis:
✅ ① gentle(완만한): 완만한 경사면이라는 문맥에 적절
❌ ② absorbs(흡수하다) → leaches: 빗물이 영양분을 '용탈한다(leaches out)'는 원문인데 absorbs(흡수하다)는 씻겨 나가는 것과 정반대 ←정답
✅ ③ reside(존재하다): 영양분이 식물에 존재한다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ illustrate(예증하다): 영양분 부족한 토양이 일반 법칙을 예증한다는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: rainfall leaches out nutrients — 빗물이 영양분을 용탈한다(leaches). absorbs(흡수하다)는 leaches의 정반대이다.

questions.passage: Differences in geology and climate make soils in different regions more or less capable of ①<u>sustained</u> agriculture. In particular, the abundant rainfall and high weathering rates on the gentle slopes of many tropical landscapes mean that after enough time, rainfall seeping into the ground leaches out almost all of the nutrients from both the soil and the ②<u>weathered</u> rocks beneath the soil. Once this happens, the lush vegetation essentially feeds on itself, retaining and recycling nutrients inherited from rocks weathered long ago. As most of the nutrients in these areas reside not in the soil but in the plants themselves, once the native vegetation ③<u>disappears</u>, so does the productive capacity of the soil. Often too few nutrients remain to support either crops or livestock within decades of deforestation. Nutrient-poor tropical soils illustrate the general rule that life ④<u>improves</u> on recycling past life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ improves(향상시키다) → depends(의존하다): 생명이 과거 생명의 재활용에 '의존한다(depends)'는 원문인데 improves(향상시키다)는 문맥과 무관
det.analysis:
✅ ① sustained(지속적인): 지속적인 농업이 가능하다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② weathered(풍화된): 풍화된 암석이라는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ disappears(사라지다): 토착 식물이 사라지면이라는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ improves(향상시키다) → depends: 'life improves on recycling past life'는 비문. 원문은 'life depends on recycling past life'(과거 생명 재활용에 의존한다) ←정답
det.tip: life depends on recycling past life — 생명은 과거 생명을 재활용하는 것에 의존한다(depends). improves(향상시키다)는 이 문맥에 맞지 않는다.

questions.passage: Differences in geology and climate make soils in different regions more or less capable of sustained agriculture. In particular, the abundant rainfall and high weathering rates on the gentle slopes of many tropical landscapes mean that after enough time, rainfall seeping into the ground leaches out almost all of the nutrients from both the soil and the weathered rocks beneath the soil. Once this happens, the lush vegetation essentially feeds on itself, retaining and recycling nutrients inherited from rocks weathered long ago. As most of the nutrients in these areas reside not in the soil but in the plants themselves, once the native vegetation disappears, so does the productive capacity of the soil. Often too few nutrients remain to support either crops or livestock within decades of deforestation. Nutrient-poor tropical soils illustrate the general rule that life depends on recycling past life.
questions.stem: 윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 불일치: 본문은 산림벌채 후 수십 년 이내에 너무 적은 영양분이 남는다고 하며, 충분한 영양분을 유지한다고 하지 않음

✅ ② 식물 자가 영양: 'the lush vegetation essentially feeds on itself, retaining and recycling nutrients'와 일치
✅ ③ 생산력 소멸: 'once the native vegetation disappears, so does the productive capacity of the soil'과 일치
❌ ④ 충분한 영양분 유지: 본문은 'too few nutrients remain to support either crops or livestock'이라고 하여 영양분이 부족하다고 함. 충분하다는 것과 정반대 ←정답(불일치)
det.tip: too few nutrients remain — 영양분이 너무 적어서 작물이나 가축을 지원할 수 없다. 충분히 유지한다는 진술은 본문과 정면 배치된다.

토착 식물이 사라지면 토양의 생산적 능력도 사라진다.
열대 지역의 토양은 산림벌채 후에도 충분한 영양분을 유지한다.
